newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady, Rotterdam barge bids firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady, Rotterdam barge bids firmer.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were steady in quiet trade on Tuesday despite some weakness on crude and product futures, traders said.

Scarce fob cargo avails after recent movement of product trans-Atlantic bolstered buying for ARA barges as traders built further cargoes for arbitrage with buying interest from the U.S. for 60kt parcels still persistent despite the currently closed arbitrage window.
On Rotterdam barges an anticipated pick up in demand from the U.S. and tighter fob cargo supplies saw Eurograde barges for early May lifting bid up to around $193 fob Rotterdam.
Buyers for prompt liftings were more relaxed around $192 while sellers for prompt and early May barges asked $195-$195.50 fob Rotterdam.
Eurograde cargoes were pegged slightly firmer at around $197/$200 cif NWE but buying interest was thin.
